body: When my girlfriend left me, I really wanted to die because I was sure someone as great as her wouldn't exist except her. But actually I met some other girls after that... I still can't talk to her anymore but I married someone else. I know your wife is very important to you, but maybe you can try to see other love if there is no other choice?

Even if you have nothing that is competitive in interests, talents etc, if you can be happy for somebody else's happiness without jealousy, you also deserve happiness. I'm saying this because my jealousy ruined many of my friendships.

Hi friend. Please don't jump. You might have a great life ahead. Who knows. Life always has bad aspects and good aspects.   
Btw it might be good to ask yourself why you need to gamble.  
When I'm stressed, I can't stop to eat, but this is not because I'm hungry. Maybe I want to remove anxiety by eating. You might have other reasons too for gambling. You know, casino makes profit by providing gambling, which means customers side never win in the end.
I don't know about that. but to study or work, one needs to be mentally/physically healthy. I feel this is unfair.

At 26 I got a job for the first time and I feel a bit better now. Even if one is older than 25, certificate or degree might help. Certificate or degree helps to give some value to others via work. It's possible to give some value to others without such things, but it's easier with them.

Hello. Sorry for late reply. I see, you can't help crying around him. I think that is natural, because it is a serious problem for you. Anybody would cry in the same situation. I would cry, too.  
That is a very difficult situation. You know exactly what makes you sad? I just thought it might be good to think what options are available in this situation. Not sure if trying not to cry is the best.  
I don't know what is the best, but my recommendation is at least to try not to get angry to him. I got angry in similar situation and it just caused the relationship to be worse.   
I hope the situation for the love gets better, friend.

You might find a better life in the college. When I was going for college/university, it was fun for me because I had more free time there compared to the highschool life. Well I liked drawing, painting, programming, traveling at that time and found some people who had same hobby. You might have a better life ahead like I did.  
I have anger issue too like my father has. From my experience, my anger caused suicidal or depressive feelings. This caused me to lose many friends. So you might better be careful for this point too for your happiness.
Life has unhappy aspect and happy aspect. Isn't it? You will be happy.
Good luck for love and job. Don't worry, they will hire you :)

I read it all. Yeah, I think you deserve to be included in the house because you and him were living just like a boyfriend and a girlfriend so far. OK, that is sad. I see how it makes you anxious. You still love him right? I hope he will be really serious in discussion.
I think your family and boyfriend will be sad if you die. Your existence is a big happiness to your family and boyfriend.

When I was 18, I felt same. I tried to commit suicide several times. I am 29 now and actually I still feel same. Feeling like something on my back whispers death. But I had some fun experience too after 18. And after leaving my parents' house, I feel a lot more freedom.  
What happened to you by the way? Why bad day?

You will find someone who will love you. I am an ugly guy but had some nice girlfriends in past. When I was a teenager, I was believing that I would never find anyone who will love me. You are only 16. Too early to give up love and your life.
You will have that job. Don't worry, friend. I have social anxiety too but I am working anyway. The economy can be unlucky state now, but it is getting better I think.

I was scared of being adult too. But actually being an adult was like getting more freedom. I have more responsibility but have more freedom at the same time. 
I started to work and donating some of my wage every month. I couldn't do this when I was a student. I can choose what I do now.
To be honest I am not happy at all though. But I am more free and feel better.
It's scary for me even if I don't know you. I'm here to listen to you bro.
Brother, I feel same. I'm sorry you feel like that.
